title: People who help us
examples: Who helps us when we are sick?
What do we do if we get lost?

explain.say: Many people help us every day. They are called community helpers.
A doctor or a nurse helps you when you are sick or hurt.

draw.text: Doctors and nurses help when you are sick or hurt

explain.say: Firefighters put out fires. Police officers help keep people safe.

draw.text: Firefighters and police officers keep us safe

explain.say: Teachers help you learn. Bus drivers take people to places.

draw.text: Teachers and bus drivers help too

explain.say: If something worries you, stop and tell a trusted grown-up. This could be a parent or a teacher.

draw.text: Stop and tell a trusted grown-up

faq.q: Who helps us when we are hurt?
faq.a: A doctor or a nurse helps us when we are hurt. They know how to make us feel better.
asks: Who takes care of sick people?

faq.q: If I am lost, who should I look for?
faq.a: Stay where you are. Ask a police officer, or a person who works there, to help you find your family.
asks: Who helps if I wander off?
Who do I ask if I am lost?

faq.a: A community helper is any person who helps keep our town safe and working. Firefighters and teachers are helpers.

faq.q: Can I ask anyone for help?
faq.a: It is best to ask a trusted adult like a parent or teacher. They know how to help you safely.
asks: Can I ask strangers for help?

faq.a: Firefighters put out fires. They wear special clothes and helmets to keep safe.
asks: Who drives the big red truck?

facts: Doctors work in clinics and hospitals.
We should always tell a trusted adult if we are scared.
Police officers help keep our streets safe.

quiz.say: Look at the red truck with a ladder. Tap who drives it.
quiz.why: Firefighters drive the fire engine. They put out fires and keep people safe.

wrong.0: A teacher helps children learn at school.
wrong.2: A doctor helps people who are sick or hurt.

quiz.say: Think of a sore tummy. Tap who can help you get better.
quiz.why: A doctor knows how to check your body. A doctor helps you get better.

wrong.1: A cook makes food for people to eat.
wrong.2: A bus driver takes people to places.

quiz.say: Think of being lost in the park. Tap the safe thing to do.
quiz.why: A police officer can help you find your family. Stay where people can see you.

wrong.0: Home may be far away, so stay in the park and ask for help.
wrong.1: Your family needs to see you, so stay where people can find you.
